skins.name: Stranded
skins.description: Recreation of clothes Highmore wore in her hometown. Custom-made flexible support materials keep the skirt puffy, while ribbons of pure white gently sway, giving form to the unknowable sea breeze.

skins.name: Phototaxis
skins.description: Ascalon's iteration from decision point F/3019226. She bids it stay for the sake of the lives of countless unbelievers, but the Seventh Sun is still determined to fall.

skins.name: Tidal Bore
skins.description: Clothes Lucilla wore when looking around an exhibit about extinct marine species. The eye is led down the outfit by the changes in color mimicking seawater at different depths, punctuated by unique patterns to form a calm, tranquil ensemble.

skins.name: The Underfur Soiree
skins.description: Miss.Christine出席晚间舞会时的装扮。朦胧轻纱搭配金色星芒挂饰，将其优雅慵懒的气质展露无遗。
